// CASE js_worker_spread_push_single expect=pass
export async function a(items, width, operation, out) {
  let next = 0;
  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
    while (next < items.length) {
      const index = next++;
      out.push(...await operation(items[index]));
    }
  }));
}
// CASE js_inorder_spread_single expect=pass
export async function inOrder(items, step, { reason }) {
  void reason;
  for (const item of items) {
    log(...await step(item));
  }
}
